snippet.title: CHRIS JUDGE Shares the Freedom That Came With Forgiving After Loss
snippet.description: Chris Judge (Stargate SG-1, God of War) joins us this week for an open, honest, and forthcoming conversation about the pain in his past and how he’s been able to not only overcome it throughout his career, but also use it to his advantage when portraying characters like Teal’c in Stargate SG-1 and Kratos in God of War.
